_comment: One-shot forced tick — read by run-tick.ts `auto` on the NAS (which git-pulls main hourly). Fires ONCE inside [notBeforeUtc, expiresUtc); the done-stamp lives in the container's data/.tmp. To arm a new one: change `key` (any new unique string) + the window + mode, commit. An expired file is inert — safe to leave in the repo. 2026-08-15: an instrumented FULL to capture the per-step failure report (tick-report.json in the R2 tar) for the 4-night NAS outage; window starts after the GH heal runs land so a failing NAS full re-uploads the ALREADY-FRESH hydrated tree (no data loss either way).
